segments.name: Applied Optics Center
segments.description: Manufactures laser filters, optical assemblies, reticles, day windows and thin film coatings for military and commercial markets.
segments.evidence: The units will be manufactured at the Applied Optics Center segment ("Applied Optics Center" or "AOC") location in Dallas, Texas.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by the U.S. Department of Defense, foreign militaries, defense prime contractors and commercial customers for build-to-customer print optical products delivered under multi-year contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: We deliver high volume products, under multi-year contracts, to large defense contractors and government customers.
